 while. i<#times do.
  j =. i+1

   while. j<#times do.
    if. (-.j{good)+.((j{times)~:1+(j-1){times)+.(j{values)~:i{values do. break. end.
    j =. j+1

   if. (j-i)>:pn 'flat_run' do.
    reason =. 1 (i+1+i.(j-i)-1)}reason

   end.
  end.

spike_test =: 3 : 0
 'times residuals values' =. y
 'w c ks d' =. num&>pv 'spike'
 flagged =. (#times)$0
 details =. 0 6$0.0
 tested =. 0
 for_i. i.#times do.
  window =. (w>:|times-i{times)#residuals
  if. (#window)<c do. continue. end.
  tested =. tested+1
  me =. median window
  mad =. median |window-me

  if. (|(i{residuals)-me)>limit do.
   flagged =. 1 i}flagged
   details =. details,(i{times),(i{values),(i{residuals),me,mad,limit

 end.
 flagged;details;tested
)
gaps =: 3 : 0

  if. (i{y)=0 do. i =. i+1

select_constituents =: 3 : 0
 chosen =. i.0
 status =. 0$a:

  state =. 'fitted'

   for_j. chosen do.
    if. ((|(i{Speeds)-j{Speeds)*y)<360*pn 'rayleigh' do. state =. 'conflict:',j{::CNames
    break. end.
   end.
  end.
  if. state-:'fitted' do. chosen =. chosen,i end.
  status =. status,<state
 end.
 chosen;status
)
angle =: 4 : 0

 r

fit =: 3 : 0
 'chosen times values' =. y
 p =. 1+2*#chosen
 a =. (p,p)$0.0
 rhs =. p$0.0
 for_i. i.#times do.
  r =. chosen regressors i{times
  a =. a+r*/r
  rhs =. rhs+r*i{values
 end.
 m =. a,.rhs,.=i.p
 for_j. i.p do.
  pivot =. j+{.\:|j}.j{"1 m
  if. pivot~:j do. old =. j{m
  m =. (pivot{m)j}m
  m =. old pivot}m end.
  for_i. (j+1)+i.(p-j)-1 do.
   f =. (<i,j){m
   f =. f%(<j,j){m
   for_c. j+i.(1+2*p)-j do. m =. (((<i,c){m)-f*(<j,c){m)(<i,c)}m end.
  end.
 end.
 sol =. (p,p+1)$0.0
 for_c. i.p+1 do.
  for_i. |.i.p do.
   s =. (<i,p+c){m
   for_j. (i+1)+i.(p-i)-1 do. s =. s-((<i,j){m)*(<j,c){sol end.
   sol =. (s%(<i,i){m)(<i,c)}sol
  end.
 end.
 coef =. 0{"1 sol
 amp =. phase =. i.0
 for_i. i.#chosen do.
  aa =. (1+2*i){coef
  bb =. (2+2*i){coef
  amp =. amp,%:(aa*aa)+bb*bb
  phase =. phase,360|((12 o.aa j.bb)*180)%3.141592653589793
 end.
 (0{coef);chosen;coef;amp;phase;(1}."1 sol)
)

datetime =: 3 : 0
 m =. Epoch+y
 day =. <.m%1440
 yr =. 1+<.day%366
 while. (days (yr+1),1 1)<:day do. yr =. yr+1 end.
 while. (days yr,1 1)>day do. yr =. yr-1 end.
 rem =. day-days yr,1 1
 md =. 31,(28+leap yr),31 30 31 30 31 31 30 31 30 31
 mo =. 0
 while. rem>:mo{md do. rem =. rem-mo{md
 mo =. mo+1 end.
 (str yr),'-',(_2{.'00',str mo+1),'-',(_2{.'00',str rem+1),' ',(_2{.'00',str <.(1440|m)%60),':',_2{.'00',str 60|m
)
